The '''Queel water dragon''' was an aquatic creature that inhabited in the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Queel]]. [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] rode one such dragon during the [[Battle of Queel|assault]] on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] positions.
